title: Sewing in Leicester: Machine Shops, Heritage and Fabric
description: A sewer’s guide to Leicester: machine sales and repairs at PK Sewing Machines, textile heritage, fabric shopping on Belgrave Road and study at DMU.
intro: Britain’s historic hosiery capital is still a great city for sewers, knitters and makers. Here is where to go.
cardText: Machine shops, heritage, fabric shopping and textile study in Leicester.

image.alt: Black sewing machine on a wooden table

blocks.heading: PK Sewing Machines, St Saviours Road
blocks.html: Family-run since 1982: new and used domestic and industrial machines, servicing listed from £35, 5,000+ spare parts and industrial call-outs across the East Midlands. Open Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00. Tel 0116 273 6552.

sections.html: PK Sewing Machines at 415 St Saviours Road, LE5 4HH, sells, services and repairs domestic and industrial machines and has a large parts department. See our PKSM profile.

Belgrave Road, known as the Golden Mile, is famous for its sari, fabric and jewellery shops and for its Diwali celebrations. It is a feast for anyone who loves colour and pattern. Leicester also has markets and independent haberdashers; check opening times before you go.
Learn about the city’s hosiery past in our heritage guide, then visit the Wigston Framework Knitters Museum just south of the city. The framework knitting museums guide has more.
De Montfort University (DMU) in Leicester teaches fashion and textile subjects and hosted the Leicester Made & Regions industry day in April 2026. Read our Leicester Made 2026 article.
